title: Pakistan Bans Manual Electricity Detection Bills
excerpt: Federal Energy Minister Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari has prohibited electricity distribution companies from issuing manual detection bills.
body_html:
Electricity consumers in Pakistan are set to receive relief following a new directive from Federal Energy Minister Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari.

The minister has officially banned manual detection billing by electricity distribution companies, commonly known as DISCOs. Companies have been directed to halt the practice immediately.

Detection bills issued manually have long been a concern for consumers. Further details regarding alternative procedures or enforcement mechanisms were not mentioned in the announcement.
